product_name: GB2591502A hair applicator (candidate architecture for Nyfasi research)
disclaimer: Independent research model. Cross-source evidence strongly supports that the GB2591502A patent family relates to Nyfasi's patented Deluxe Detangler: RAEng and Le Journal de Mayotte identify the Deluxe Detangler as Nyfasi's patented product, while the patent family lists inventor Youmna Mouhamad and assignee Myana Naturals Ltd. The exact publication-to-retail-SKU/revision mapping is not directly confirmed by a primary source and remains marked unverified. Patent embodiment features are supported as disclosures only; retail configuration, exact geometry, dimensions and internal details remain unverified. Not official Nyfasi CAD or manufacturing geometry.
